def verify_memory(model):
    # Deterministic probes consume no training, sampling, or worker RNG state.
    device = model.memory_decay_logit.device
    dtype = model.item_emb.weight.dtype
    embeddings = torch.arange(
        4 * model.hidden, device=device, dtype=dtype
    ).reshape(1, 4, model.hidden) / model.hidden
    mask = embeddings.new_ones(1, 4, 1)
    pooled = model._prefix_mean(embeddings, mask)
    decay = torch.sigmoid(model.memory_decay_logit)
    for end in range(1, 5):
        weights = decay ** torch.arange(
            end - 1, -1, -1, device=device, dtype=dtype
        )
        expected = (
            embeddings[:, :end] * weights[None, :, None]
        ).sum(dim=1) / weights.sum()
        torch.testing.assert_close(pooled[:, end - 1], expected)
        torch.testing.assert_close(
            model._prefix_mean(embeddings[:, :end], mask[:, :end]),
            pooled[:, :end],
        )
    padded = embeddings.new_full((1, 7, model.hidden), 17.0)
    positions = torch.tensor([1, 2, 4, 6], device=device)
    padded[:, positions] = embeddings
    padded_mask = embeddings.new_zeros(1, 7, 1)
    padded_mask[:, positions] = 1
    padded_pool = model._prefix_mean(padded, padded_mask)
    torch.testing.assert_close(padded_pool[:, positions], pooled)
    assert torch.count_nonzero(padded_pool[:, [0, 3, 5]]).item() == 0
    empty_pool = model._prefix_mean(embeddings, torch.zeros_like(mask))
    assert torch.isfinite(empty_pool).all().item()
    assert torch.count_nonzero(empty_pool).item() == 0
    gradient, = torch.autograd.grad(pooled.square().mean(), model.memory_decay_logit)
    assert torch.isfinite(gradient).item()
    assert gradient.abs().item() > 0

    was_training = model.training
    model.eval()
    try:
        with torch.no_grad():
            seq = torch.tensor(
                [[1, min(2, model.itemnum), 1, min(3, model.itemnum)]],
                device=device, dtype=torch.long,
            )
            features = model(seq)
            for end in range(1, 5):
                torch.testing.assert_close(
                    model(seq[:, :end]), features[:, :end],
                    rtol=1e-4, atol=1e-5,
                )
            left_padded = F.pad(seq, (2, 0))
            padded_features = model(left_padded)
            torch.testing.assert_close(
                padded_features[:, 2:], features, rtol=1e-4, atol=1e-5
            )
            assert torch.count_nonzero(padded_features[:, :2]).item() == 0
            empty_features = model(torch.zeros_like(left_padded))
            assert torch.isfinite(empty_features).all().item()
            assert torch.count_nonzero(empty_features).item() == 0
    finally:
        model.train(was_training)
